headline: WNBA Finals Game 4: Valkyries at Dream, Atlanta leads 2-1
whyCareReason: Atlanta can clinch their first WNBA title with a win on Friday. Valkyries fight to force Game 5.
teaser: Friday 23 October, 8:00 p.m. ET, State Farm Arena, USA/Peacock/CNBC. Dream lead 2-1 after 97-71 Game 3 rout.
story: Game 4 of the WNBA Finals is scheduled for Friday, 23 October, at State Farm Arena in Atlanta. Tip is listed at 8:00 p.m. ET on USA Network, Peacock and CNBC. The Atlanta Dream hold a 2-1 series lead following their 97-71 blowout victory in Game 3, in which Angel Reese tallied 21 points and 12 rebounds. A victory on Friday would secure the Dream their first championship in franchise history. The Golden State Valkyries must win to extend the series to a deciding Game 5 back in San Francisco. No score is posted for Friday.
stakes: Championship point for Atlanta. Golden State face elimination and need a road victory to keep their title hopes alive.
rivalryAngle: The expansion Valkyries face their first elimination game of the Finals in Atlanta.
funFacts: Atlanta leads the series 2-1 after winning Games 2 and 3 by double digits.
Game 4: Friday 23 October, 8:00 p.m. ET, State Farm Arena. Status upcoming.
Series history: Game 1 Valkyries 68-64; Game 2 Dream 79-65; Game 3 Dream 97-71.
